tabs.overview: A towable trailer with a break area, restrooms and wash-up, placed on the service side of the pad away from the pumps and the well row. It is also where crews go on a stop-work.
tabs.engineering: Placement by the pad layout; a generator or the pad power feeds it.
tabs.safety: Outside the red zone and upwind of the flare and flowback where the layout allows; the muster point is not here but at the safety station.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout and proportion only (S9).
